alt: 救災隊長在地圖上安排避開積水路段的物資運送路線，隊友在旁聆聽準備。
scene_prompt: 運籌帷幄 means skillfully planning strategy and coordinating action. A modern community emergency-response planning room after a storm: a calm coordinator studies a large map with simple colored route lines and landmark icons but no words, arranging small vehicle tokens to plan the safest supply route around a flooded road. Teammates listen and prepare supplies, showing careful forethought and coordination from a sheltered operations center. No active disaster danger or readable signs. Natural anatomy with two arms and legs each; hands place tokens realistically; map lies flat, table and objects supported, perspective sensible.
